$comment: Per-declaration assurance for Broiler.DOM. Product projects only: the two shipping libraries Broiler.Dom and Broiler.Dom.Html. Broiler.Dom.Tests and Broiler.Dom.Html.Tests are not listed, so they are not covered. No tracked source is generated (the [GeneratedRegex] bodies are written to obj/ at build time and are never walked), so nothing is excluded. No source here is third-party-derived (docs/dom-ip-licensing-register.md, DOM-IP-003/004 and DOM-SRC-001), so there are no spdxOverrides. HUMAN_REVIEW.md is the hand-written, revision-scoped release record and is left untouched; the per-unit record is written to HUMAN_REVIEW.units.md.
regenerateCommand: dotnet run --project Broiler.Code/src/Broiler.Code.Review.Cli -c Release -- assurance generate --root Broiler.DOM
